phases.name: identity-observability
requirements: 1 fix every syntax defect including the joined evABS/sessOn declaration
2 identify release as A16A, lineage A16, and retain explicit AIC9Z legacy import compatibility
3 create one shared sensor observability engine used by control, learning, jump, dashboard and diagnostics
4 continuously learn separate GPS acceleration/braking lag and RPM acceleration/deceleration lag only in eligible clean periods
5 detect plausible frozen GPS/RPM, repeated telemetry frames, spikes and impossible movement, degrading authority gradually

phases.name: authority-control
requirements: 6 add one final authority arbiter with priority, confidence, requested command, cap, slew, fail-open floor and reason
7 add compact per-episode intervention budgets for cumulative cut, duration, peak, pulses and recovery
8 implement evidence-driven linear release with retrigger hysteresis
9 separate post-landing traction resynchronization from ordinary TC
27 implement explicit reconnect probation: fail-open, clear intervention, reacquire, validate, restore context, enable control, enable learning last
28 periodically verify critical GVar readback and latch safe fallback on persistent mismatch
29 add a complete-cycle watchdog that forces GV7 1024, TC/ABS inactive and learning blocked on invalid or incomplete control cycles

phases.name: jump-episodes
requirements: 10 use an explicit grounded, unload, takeoff, airborne, descent, landing, settle, resolved jump state machine
11 classify false jumps by wheelspin, GPS dropout, RPM spike, rough ground, acceleration, braking, steering mismatch, disagreement, short duration or retained ground evidence
12 provide compact optional momentary-switch labeling of the most recent jump candidate as true or false without controlling the car
24 maintain one compact causal episode record with id, trigger, cause/confidence, observability, requested/actual intervention, peak, duration, outcome and learning action
25 record prediction, actual result, error and parameter response
26 represent unknown, ambiguous, mixed and sensor-invalid causes rather than forcing certainty

phases.name: learning-neural
requirements: 13 replace broad attribution with eligibility traces opened by decisions and closed by measured outcomes
14 implement champion/challenger deltas in shadow, promotion after repeated evidence and rollback on degradation
15 keep separate traction, braking, surface, jump, truth, driver and neural confidence
16 keep the existing small neural topology but add normalized features, eligibility, target-specific training, clipped updates, poor-observability blocking, validation and rollback
17 ensure every new learned state has a complete observation-feature-update-decision-outcome-retain-or-rollback path

phases.name: persistence-runtime
requirements: 18 implement alternating transactional memory files with generation, completed marker and validation while retaining AIC9Z import
19 validate exact schema, field count, finite/range values, generation and compact checksum before accepting memory
20 separate long-term stable, session-adaptive, episode-only and diagnostic-only persistence
21 reduce blackbox file-open churn by grouping short burst writes while always failing open
22 remove large repeated save-string concatenation and use MT12-compatible global io.write in bounded chunks
23 add a runtime pressure governor that defers only voice preference, calm diagnostics, trait work and nonurgent UI, never sensing or control

preserve: TC, ABS, gyro, launch, surface and learning behavior unless a measured safety improvement replaces the implementation
MT12 global io.read(fileHandle,...) and io.write(fileHandle,...) forms
no simplification or feature removal to save memory
